title: cooking-rs ingredient catalog
description: ingredients.json: key → catalog entry. Validated for real by `cargo test` (src/validate.rs); this schema is for editor autocomplete.

unit.description: The shopping unit: how the ingredient is bought and summed. Recipes may use any convertible unit.

count.description: How the ingredient is counted in pieces.

label.description: Name of one piece (clove, can, slice). Recipes may use it as a unit.

plural.description: Plural of label if not label + "s".

per_piece.description: How much of the shopping unit one piece is (150 for a 150 g onion). For a pcs-shopped ingredient: grams per piece.
